These are negative fixtures for German town-sign recognition. The JSON records
the tight direction-board box in top-left normalized image coordinates.
Both photos were resized and recompressed as JPEG for the native test bundles.

- `kiel-direction.jpg`: [Zeichen 419-20 und 415-20 STVO](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Zeichen_419-20_und_415-20_STVO.jpg)
  by Siegbert Brey, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
- `historic-direction.jpg`: [Zeichen 438 – Vorwegweiser](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Zeichen_438_-_Vorwegweiser_(nach_Bild_47_der_StVO_1956),_StVO_1971.png)
  by Mediatus, [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).
